associations.rationale: From split maps after extension to L, the formal type produces a finitely generated K-subalgebra R carrying split maps, supplying the descent step of the stated proof strategy.

For a finite field extension, the formal type turns a split base-changed pair of maps into a split pair over A; it packages the finite-extension consequence rather than stating the full descent-specialization-cancellation strategy.
The displayed formal type is a positive-n implication between split-map existentials and does not display finite powers, so it can only support the claimed power-cancellation step.
